messages:
Iris: Quick sync — final copy lock for the product launch post. Need hero + 3 bullets + bench blurb + CTAs. Also need HubSpot hidden fields and publish window. 20m please. :clock2:
Diego: Taking hero + social headline. Will post two short options in the doc in 10.
Harpreet: I'll draft benchmark paragraph and include one-line test context (hw, avg seq, harness). Will avoid absolutes per previous guidance.
Kiran: I'll wire the HubSpot form mapping and set UTMs. Need final utm_campaign name. Also confirm demo slot names so event maps cleanly.
Leah: Webinar ops — we have pods at 14:00 and 20:00 UTC. Recommend 20:00 for broader coverage. I can pin that and update Calendly after CTAs are locked.
Sam (Legal): Quick heads-up: use "up to" for comparisons and add "in our internal benchmarks". Approve language with those qualifiers; can sign off by 4pm. Avoid words like "always" or "guarantee".
Diego: Dropped doc link with copy options: https://docs.google.com/xxx — choosing hero v1 (concise). Social headline A: "Predictable inference, out of the box." Social B: "Ship LLM features at predictable latency & cost."
Harpreet: Bench draft: "median latency up to 3.2x faster, p95 up to 1.7x in our internal benchmarks (tests run on a 1x A100-equivalent; mixed batch, avg seq ~128; perf-harness:v3)." Keeping qualifiers per legal.
Kiran: Proposed HubSpot hidden fields for the form (paste-ready):
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: newsletter
  utm_campaign: launch_beta_june
  demo_slot: 20:00
  lead_route: launch_inbound
```
Kiran: Routing logic: utm_campaign=launch_beta_june -> assign to queue "launch-inbound"; company_size>250 -> route to "Enterprise AE"; tag sf_lead: "beta_interest".
Leah: Pinned 20:00 UTC demo pod, updated event title to "Redwood Launch Demo". RSVP flow tested and confirmation email looks good.
Sam (Legal): Reviewed doc and approved current bench wording and CTAs. For "Request a dedicated eval" add parenthetical "(subject to qualification)". Signed off in doc comments.
Iris: Final CTAs: primary = "Register for launch demo"; secondary = "Request a dedicated eval (subject to qualification)". Social thread and short press blurb included in the doc.
Diego: Added alt headline for LinkedIn card and a 3-tweet thread version for X. Also included UTM examples for email, social, and partner banners.
Harpreet: Tiny edit to bench blurb to explicitly call out the workload mix (short/medium sequences) — done.
Iris: Proposed publish window = tomorrow 11:00 PT. If no flags by 4pm today I'll schedule publication and queue the social thread for +2 minutes after publish. :rocket:
Kiran: I'll run one final test submission to HubSpot after publish scheduling to validate routing.
Leah: Ops all green. Calendar invite confirmed.
Sam (Legal): Sign-off logged.
Iris: Thanks everyone — locking copy and routing. Closing thread.
